kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نختمر (form VIII)
# نَخْتَمِرُ (naḵtamiru) /nax.ta.mi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَمَرَ (iḵtamara)
# نَخْتَمِرَ (naḵtamira) /nax.ta.mi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَمَرَ (iḵtamara)
# نَخْتَمِرْ (naḵtamir) /nax.ta.mir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِخْتَمَرَ (iḵtamara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
